watches.name: Oceanguard GMT - Jet Wash White
watches.description: THIS MODEL IS CURRENTLY SOLD OUT. SIGN UP FOR DROP NOTIFICATIONS. Introducing our first GMT model, the Oceanguard! The Oceanguard features a dual timezone complication which uses a fourth hand to keep track of two time zones at once making it the perfect travel companion! Its custom 24-hour bezel insert, available in three different colorways, features hand-drawn, vintage-styled font that captures the feeling of air travel from the 1950s. This colorway showcases the iconic red and blue “Pepsi'' bezel seen on some of the most iconic vintage GMTs from history. The use of two distinct colors provides an appealing and useful way to differentiate daylight and nighttime hours. In addition, this is the only white dial option available! Originally created as a useful tool for pilots, the GMT’s ability to track local and home time has made it an essential item for ships’ captains, navigators, and world travelers for decades. With the Oceanguard, we set out to capture that utilitarian and adventure-seeking spirit. But we took it even further! In addition to a four-hand calibre with custom red and black roulette date wheel and hand-drawn, serif font, the Oceanguard features a custom friction-fit bezel affording a smooth bi-directional rotation; a color palette of vintage-inspired tones and notes; and an all-brushed 5-link steel bracelet. Elements such as the date wheel’s highly desirable “flat three” and “open six and nine” numerals, as well as custom bracelet with on-the-fly microadjustment , make the Oceanguard truly one of a kind! And as if that weren't enough, each Oceanguard comes with functional packaging in the form of a custom leather travel case perfect for your next adventure! With a heavy nod to the vintage skin divers of the 1950s, designed to be sleek, elegant, and more wearable timepieces for the gentleman diver; combined with the precision, quality, and attitude of the modern-day dive watch, the Royalguard 200 aims to bring back that stylish and timeless look while adding modern-day functionality. With its carefully crafted 38mm case, refined proportions, tapering bracelet, 200m of water resistance, and an accurate and reliable automatic mechanical caliber, the Royalguard 200 perfectly combines the elements of the vintage watch aesthetic with the quality and precision of modern day watchmaking. Its design and attention to detail make it a watch you won’t ever want to take off, no matter the occasion. “Elegant enough for royalty. Tough enough for the royal guard." - The Royalguard 200 was built on this idea. I sought to design a watch stylish enough to be at home on the wrist of the renowned and revered, yet tough enough (and affordable enough) to accompany everyone.
